test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

We yet / have time / to catch / the bus.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'We yet'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'We still' **should be used instead of **'We yet'.**
 
• The word **still** refers to an event/action that has begun in the past time and is **continuing** in **the present time**.
